findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V144 renders shows the overskirt remains severely irregular and creased despite the isolated bending-stiffness increase to 2.2. The neutral surface has busy crumpled folds and an uneven, jagged hem across front, back, and side views; the isolated cloth parameter change did not produce a controlled pleated silhouette.

Crouch exposes the upper thighs and folds the overskirt away from the legs; sit collapses it into a bunched bundle, while prone spreads it into a broad irregular sheet. Static cloth settling plus the stiffer bending hypothesis does not provide acceptable pose-dependent garment behavior.
The abrupt waist-to-hip transition and angular torso/skirt-side surface artifacts remain visible in the current render set.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. Stop tuning this cloth stiffness parameter: V144 renders show no adequate visual improvement over V143. Change the garment construction method by revising the overskirt panel geometry and pose deformation strategy, resolve the waist/hip transition and torso artifacts, then regenerate and directly inspect all eleven views. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, and VRChat remain independent unverified gates.
